components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #0071e3; color: #fff; padding: 12px 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 17px; letter-spacing: -0.022em; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0077ed; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0071e3; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Link
components.css: .ds-text-link { color: #0071e3; font-size: 17px; text-decoration: none; display: inline-flex; gap: 4px; } .ds-text-link:hover { opacity: 0.7; } .ds-text-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0071e3; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: White and mist fields, ink chrome, one blue for action. Playlists are the product. Type does the hierarchy.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Blue is for doing, never a fill.

rules.name: The Tonal Field Rule
rules.body: Depth from paper, mist, and ink bands.

dos: Keep the page mostly paper and mist.
donts: Don't restore gradient heroes or glass cards.
Don't add eyebrows or a second accent.
